rationale: The stock is trading near the top of its intraday range (91% position) following a significant gap-down, indicating that the initial selling pressure has been absorbed but there is no confirmed momentum to break out to new highs. Entering long here offers a poor risk-reward ratio due to the proximity to the session high and the lack of volume expansion in the most recent candles to support a breakout, while shorting against the immediate upward drift is counter-trend.
